en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town situated in a valley, surrounded by wooded hills and distant mountains. A straight, tree‑lined avenue runs from the foreground deep into the town. There are dense blocks of multi‑storey residential and institutional buildings in the foreground, with scattered houses, fields and some church spires further back. At the bottom edge of the image there is German text printed in white identifying the view, along with a small serial number.
